title: Services
subtitle: Publishing support for authors — from manuscript to finished book.
intro: We work with every author individually and shape the collaboration around the specific text, length and goal. The price of each service is calculated personally once we have seen the manuscript.

orderIntro: Send us an email — we will reply with a preliminary quote and a work plan.
orderChecklist: The name of the service you are interested in
Your name and how to reach you
A short description of the manuscript: genre, length, how finished it is
Preferred timeline and print run, if you already know them
The manuscript or an excerpt — if you are ready to share it
outro: We usually reply within a few working days.
